omar: heads up during quasar50k-int3 onboarding i found a reproducible KV misalignment when enabling dynamic-kv-shuffle + rope-per-layer at ~20k tokens. only on int3 path. logs and tiny repro below.
sylvie: can you paste the exact repro command and whether this is on canary or local?
omar: canary (1xH100), repro: 
```
python infra/run_infer.py --model quasar50k-int3-v0 --quant int3 --dynamic-kv-shuffle true \
  --rope-rescale per-layer --context 51200 --prefill examples/very_long_prefill.txt --dump-kv /tmp/q_kv.json
```
omar: log tail: 
```
[prefill] done pos=19984
[shuffle] remap applied at checkpoint
[kv] mismatch at pos=19968 expected=0x9c33 got=0x9c32
[rebuild-kv] triggered
```
sylvie: sounds like shuffle remap plus int3 packing is losing a low bit during page index math. does forcing FULL_INDEX_WIDTH=32 help?
omar: yes forcing FULL_INDEX_WIDTH=32 fixes the mismatch. int8/fp16 unaffected.
anna: dev-bot creating INC-2026-4242: "quasar50k-int3 dynamic-kv-shuffle index truncation with RoPE per-layer" and linking this thread.
sylvie: for onboarding: add dynamic-kv-shuffle smoke at 32k/50k across quant packs and compare kv-hash prefixes. also add an int-bitwidth unit test for shuffle remap.
omar: i'll open a small runtime PR to widen index math and include perf notes (index widen adds ~1.2% metadata RAM for quasar50k config). will paste link once ready.
sylvie: also run token-diff benchmark across fp16/int8/int3 after PR to ensure no token-level regressions.
omar: will run overnight and report. thanks all.
